abilities.desc_zh: 远程攻击发射独特的玻璃瓦斯，使对手进入“脆化” (Brittle) 状态，对手护甲瞬间归零，受到的暴击伤害提升 50%。
abilities.desc_en: Ranged attacks coat targets in Glass Gas, inflicting Brittle. The target Armor is reduced to 0 and incoming Critical Damage increases by 50%.

abilities.desc_zh: 面对体型大于自身的敌人时，攻击力额外提升 30%，且免疫任何嘲讽与恐惧效果。
abilities.desc_en: Deals 30% more Attack against foes larger than himself, and becomes immune to Taunt and Fear.

abilities.desc_zh: 面对具有闪避 (Evade) 或隐形能力的敌人时，飞过山精准度提高 100%，攻击绝对无法被闪避。
abilities.desc_en: Against opponents with Evade or Cloaking abilities, Cliffjumper gains 100% Precision, making his attacks unevadable.

abilities.desc_zh: 暴击命中处于脆化状态的敌人时，有 60% 概率触发玻璃粉碎爆炸，造成巨额真实伤害并击晕对手 2 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Critical Hits against Brittle opponents have a 60% chance to trigger Glass Shatter, inflicting massive true damage and 2s Stun.

abilities.desc_zh: 近距离轰出高浓缩玻璃瓦斯火箭弹，直接击碎敌方护甲，施加破甲削减 {{var_1}} 护甲持续 {{var_2}} 秒并击退。
abilities.desc_en: Fires a concentrated Glass Gas rocket at close range, shattering Armor by {{var_1}} for {{var_2}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 飞过山以红色跑车漂移后翻滚射击，有 {{var_3}} 几率造成暴击，并在 {{var_4}} 秒内提升自身 {{var_5}} 攻击力。
abilities.desc_en: Drifts and emerges firing, with a {{var_3}} chance to Critically hit and gaining +{{var_5}} Attack for {{var_4}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 零距离引爆高浓缩玻璃瓦斯核芯，施加脆化，使敌方受到的暴击伤害提升 {{var_6}} 持续 {{var_7}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Detonates a Glass Gas core at point-blank range, inflicting Brittle boosting incoming Critical Damage by {{var_6}} for {{var_7}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 与G1擎天柱同队时，获得 +{{var_1}} 攻击力与 +{{var_2}} 暴击率。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_1}} Attack and +{{var_2}} Critical Rating when teamed with Optimus Prime.

abilities.desc_zh: 与大黄蜂同队时，所有暴击伤害提升 {{var_3}}。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_3}} Critical Damage when teamed with Bumblebee.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_4}} 破甲效果。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_4}} Armor Piercing.
